Aleks: Quick heads-up — external pen test confirmed for Tue 09:00 PT. Scope explicitly includes KMS integrations, RBAC change windows, and audit log exports. Need a short runbook for intake + evidence packaging + retest ownership. Who can take retest coord?
Maya: I can own retest coordination. Quick questions: do we want 100% audit sampling for the test or just high-risk actions? Also plan to enable ephemeral tester roles.
Jon: Recommend 100% for the window (we want full traceability). For KMS: restrict decrypt/GenerateDataKey to a kms-proxy service account during the window. That avoids exposing raw keys to assessees.
Tara: Ops/oncall here — we'll schedule temporary alert thresholds and a quiet-window policy so the pen test doesn't flap monitor paging. Need list of metrics to mute and which to escalate.
sre-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: `pen-test-1738888000` 2024-05-14T16:00Z -> 2024-05-14T18:00Z. Notifications sent to #eng-oncall.
Maya: Evidence packaging plan: presigned S3 uploads for logs & snapshots. We'll create a single bucket `redwood-pt-evidence-1738888` with lifecycle 90d. Assessor gets pre-signed PUT URLs, we collect a manifest file.
Aleks: Good. On RBAC changes: we need a disposable role name + scoped policies and an audit trail of role grants. Sample policy snippet for the pen-test role (please review):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["logs:DescribeLogGroups","logs:GetLogEvents","logs:FilterLogEvents"], "Resource": "*" },
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/pt-sandbox-key", "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:CalledVia": "kms-proxy.redwood.internal"}} }
  ]
}
```
Jon: That Condition on `aws:CalledVia` is perfect — forces calls through the proxy. We also need an audit flag on the proxy to log `GenerateDataKey` requests with principal.
Maya: For evidence, include `assessor-id`, `request-id`, and trimmed stack traces. We should also snapshot KV-cache state for models touched during the test (if any).
Tara: Ops note — will open a short-lived support channel during the window and a post-test triage call 1hr after end. Who should be on the triage?
Maya: Please invite me, Aleks, Jon, and the assessor lead. I'll do a quick checklist during triage: verify evidence receipt, check RBAC rollback, confirm key rotations if applied.
Aleks: Action items summary: 1) Maya — retest & triage owner; create evidence bucket + presigned URL flow (due EOD today). 2) Jon — implement kms-proxy condition & logging; provide proof of logs (due EOD). 3) Tara — muted alerts list + create support channel + schedule triage call (due EOD). 4) Security — policy for ephemeral role creation & automated rollback (we'll reuse existing `ephemeral-role-runbook`).
Maya: I'll post the presigned URL script and manifest format here when ready. Example manifest fields: `object_key, assessor_id, captured_at, sha256, notes`.
Jon: I'll push a small proxy logging change and drop a link to logs after merge. `PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kms-proxy/pulls/432`
Tara: Channel for realtime help: #pt-1738888000-support. Invite sent.
Aleks: Final question — retest window timing? Propose retest 2 weeks after fixes merged + evidence available, 48h window. Agree?
Maya: Agree. I'll lock retest slot after fixes verified.
Aleks: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll update the high-level intake ticket with owners and attach this thread. :thumbsup:
